blockers.detail: M changes dlltool leading_underscore from int to char* and updates dll_name_set_by_exp_name/identify_strict; the old fuzz_dlltool does not reset these globals between inputs, so state leaks across inputs (the line points at the new global, not at a coverage-measured gap).

evidence: H patch (OSS-Fuzz #13064) updates projects/binutils/fuzz_dlltool.c and build.sh
input/source is the complete binutils 2.44 release tree (6cf91d2b68768c936ea67a51cd5232f43ad188cf), which contains M; change.diff is M^1->M
baseline build/run used binutils 2.43.1 release (ddf04874fa6ec0a0d10f813b245c33ce19c50473), a pre-M ancestor; old fuzz_dlltool exit 0 on two .def inputs

rationale.zh: binutils M (`dlltool leading_underscore`) 改变 dlltool 的 leading_underscore 类型/默认值，并引入新的 dll_name_set_by_exp_name 状态；旧 fuzz_dlltool 没有重置这些全局状态；H 更新 init_dlltool_global_state。
rationale.en: binutils M ('dlltool leading_underscore') changes the leading_underscore type/default and dll_name_set_by_exp_name state; the old fuzz_dlltool does not reset them. H updates init_dlltool_global_state.
